 New traders can snag the Novig promo code NYPOST to claim $50 in trade credits with Sydney Sweeney for Mavericks vs. Timberwolves.
 Dallas heads to Minnesota riding the momentum of Cooper Flagg’s 43-point explosion against Indiana, facing a Timberwolves team that has opened the season 8-3.
 The Mavericks have already won seven games after managing just 26 victories last season, but face a tougher test Thursday as 6.5-point underdogs against the third-place Timberwolves.

 What our Post expert thinks about Mavericks vs. Timberwolves
 Flagg was nearly unstoppable in Dallas’ 125-122 win over the Pacers, shooting 16-for-25 while adding 10 rebounds and six assists in 39 minutes.
 Minnesota will be without superstar Anthony Edwards due to a knee injury, while Donte DiVincenzo is also sidelined with an Achilles issue.
 Dallas shot 51.8 percent from the field against Indiana but surrendered 52.4 percent shooting on the other end, a defensive vulnerability that could complicate its bid for another road victory.
